findings.highlight: I am inexperienced as a Master
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師として未熟な俺
findings.governingReading: I am an inexperienced magus
findings.explanation: Shirou’s lack of skill as a magus is reassigned to his new status as a Master.

findings.highlight: It’s not like I want to go with his plan
findings.evidenceJa: 言峰に誑かされるワケじゃない
findings.governingReading: it is not that Kotomine has talked or duped me into this
findings.explanation: Resistance to Kotomine’s manipulation becomes a lack of desire to follow his plan.

findings.highlight: using myself as bait is the only viable plan I can come up with
findings.evidenceJa: 餌にして敵の食いつきを待つぐらいしか思いつかない
findings.governingReading: the only thing I can think of is using myself as bait and waiting for the enemy to bite
findings.explanation: The English promotes Shirou’s sole available idea into an objectively viable plan and drops the waiting-and-biting image.

findings.highlight: a Master is planning something evil
findings.evidenceJa: 物騒な事を企んでいるマスター
findings.governingReading: a Master is plotting something dangerous or violent
findings.explanation: A practical threat assessment becomes a moral declaration of evil.

findings.highlight: Then let us go
findings.evidenceJa: 隣町に向かいましょう
findings.governingReading: then let us head to the neighboring town
findings.explanation: Saber’s geographical description of Shinto is omitted.

findings.highlight: I must accept the possibility that I’ll be killed
findings.evidenceJa: 殺される覚悟を決めなければいけない
findings.governingReading: I have to resolve myself to being killed
findings.explanation: Required mortal resolve is weakened to acknowledging a possibility.

findings.highlight: I’m a total rookie, but I’ve trained my mind as a magus
findings.evidenceJa: 半人前とは言え、魔術師としての心構え
findings.governingReading: though only half-trained, I have cultivated a magus’s mental readiness
findings.explanation: Shirou’s measured appraisal and specific professional discipline become a casual declaration that he is a total rookie.

findings.highlight: I steel up my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 心に鍵をかけて
findings.governingReading: locking my heart
findings.explanation: Shirou’s deliberate emotional closure becomes generic mental resolve.

findings.highlight: when I insert the Magic Circuit into my back
findings.evidenceJa: 背中に魔術回路を入れるように
findings.governingReading: as when I switch on the Magic Circuit in my back
findings.explanation: Circuit activation is misdescribed as physically inserting a circuit into Shirou’s back.

findings.highlight: detected no signs of other Servants
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントの気配を感じなかった
findings.governingReading: sensed no Servant presence
findings.explanation: The singular class of presence becomes evidence of multiple other Servants.

findings.highlight: your skills are not up to par
findings.evidenceJa: シロウの技量が考えに付いてこなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s skill could not keep pace with the plan
findings.explanation: Saber’s precise diagnosis of a mismatch between conception and execution becomes a generic judgment of poor skill.

findings.highlight: if we continue this every night
findings.evidenceJa: 積み重ねていけば
findings.governingReading: if we keep accumulating such patrols
findings.explanation: The English adds a fixed nightly schedule to Saber’s general claim about cumulative effort.

findings.highlight: we’re failing due to my lack of skill
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の力不足で事が成らない
findings.governingReading: things fail to come about because my own ability is insufficient
findings.explanation: Shirou’s private sense of personal inadequacy is reframed as a collective failure.

findings.highlight: Miyama City
findings.evidenceJa: 深山町
findings.governingReading: Miyama Town
findings.explanation: The district name is mistranslated as a city.

findings.highlight: confirm the safety in our area
findings.evidenceJa: 足場の確認をしなければ
findings.governingReading: first establish or inspect our footing on home ground
findings.explanation: Saber’s tactical need to establish their base terrain becomes a safety check.

findings.highlight: We cross the bridge
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと橋を渡る
findings.governingReading: I cross the bridge with Saber
findings.explanation: Saber’s explicit presence in the silent crossing is omitted.

findings.highlight: We may be able to save the person who screamed if we move quickly
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の指示次第では、悲鳴をあげた人間を助ける事も出来る
findings.governingReading: depending on your order, we should be able to save the person who screamed
findings.explanation: The rescue depends on Shirou issuing an order; the English changes the condition to moving quickly.

findings.highlight: That erases everything
findings.evidenceJa: 落ち着いたセイバーの声のおかげか
findings.governingReading: perhaps thanks to Saber’s calm voice
findings.explanation: Saber’s composure as the cause of Shirou’s recovery is omitted and replaced by an unanchored assertion that everything vanishes.

findings.highlight: disappears
findings.evidenceJa: ぎこちなくはあるが解けていった
findings.governingReading: began to release, awkwardly but surely
findings.explanation: A gradual, imperfect recovery becomes instantaneous disappearance.

findings.highlight: The numbness throughout my body
findings.evidenceJa: 固まっていた頭、手足の痺れ
findings.governingReading: my frozen mind and numb hands and feet
findings.explanation: Mental paralysis and specified extremities again collapse into generalized bodily numbness.

findings.highlight: The fear that I might kill
findings.evidenceJa: 殺し合いをする、という畏れ
findings.governingReading: the dread of entering a fight to the death
findings.explanation: Fear of reciprocal mortal combat is again reassigned solely to Shirou killing.

findings.highlight: I apologize for my cowardice
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の不甲斐なさを詫びて
findings.governingReading: I apologize for my own pathetic inadequacy
findings.explanation: The repeated branch again narrows Shirou’s failure to the moral trait cowardice.

findings.highlight: We run
findings.evidenceJa: 全力で走り出す
findings.governingReading: I break into a full-speed run
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recovered action is again reassigned to both him and Saber.

findings.highlight: where we will fight someone to the death
findings.evidenceJa: 不吉な魔力が残る殺し合いの場へ
findings.governingReading: toward the scene of mortal combat where ominous magical energy lingers
findings.explanation: The repeated branch again drops the lingering magical evidence.

findings.highlight: My limbs are shaking as I run
findings.evidenceJa: 走り出す足は震えている
findings.governingReading: the feet carrying me into a run are trembling
findings.explanation: The repeated contradiction of running on trembling feet becomes generalized limb shaking.

findings.highlight: If I have a reason to fight, I must believe in it
findings.evidenceJa: 戦うと決めた理由があるのなら、まずそれを抱かなければならなかった
findings.governingReading: if I have a reason I chose to fight, I first have to take that desire into myself
findings.explanation: The repeated branch again changes emotional self-armament into generic belief.

findings.highlight: If my enemies are arming their minds with “the desire for the Holy Grail”
findings.evidenceJa: 相手が“聖杯が欲しい”という願望で心を武装するのなら
findings.governingReading: if an opponent arms their heart with the desire to possess the Grail
findings.explanation: The singular opponent becomes plural enemies, and heart becomes mind.

findings.highlight: “the desire to stop all conflicts”
findings.evidenceJa: “戦いを止める”という願望
findings.governingReading: the desire to stop the fighting
findings.explanation: The present fight is again expanded into every conflict.
